title: Throttle Sensor Supply Voltage High Error
detail_of_failure: High voltage (5.25V and above) is sensed in the throttle sensor power supply circuit.
controller_action: Operates the engine at the throttle position set by the signal from other than throttle sensor.
machine_effect: Engine speed cannot be controlled with the fuel dial.
related_information: After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “RELATED INFORMA- TION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector P20. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. If this failure code is cleared, the throttle sensor is defective. Other failure codes are shown, too. This occurs because the connector is disconnected. Ignore failure codes other than this failure code [CA2185].
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors CE02, CE03 and P20, and connect a T-adapter to the female sides of CE02 and CE03.

measurements.point: Between CE02 (female) (22) and each pin other than CE02 (female) (22) pin.

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector P20. Connect a T-adapter to the female side. 3. Starting switch: ON
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector CE02. Connect a T-adapter to the male side. 3. Turn the starting switch to the ON position with the wiring harness disconnected.
